evidence.observation: Growth pressure was 3.014 Torr at an Ar setpoint of 100 sccm.
Pressure rose to 3.162 Torr with unchanged growth setpoints.
Pressure continued rising to 3.361 Torr while Ar remained near setpoint at 99.5 sccm and temperature at 749.8 °C; this indicates a pressure anomaly despite stable controls.
Exhaust O2 sensor is not installed; null O2 readings cannot verify the required growth atmosphere.
